To run the Ollama container with access to all NVIDIA GPUs, use the `--gpus=all` flag:

```bash
docker run -d --gpus=all -v ollama:/root/.ollama -p 11434:11434 --name ollama ollama/ollama
```

- `--gpus=all` exposes every NVIDIA GPU on the host to the container.
- `-v ollama:/root/.ollama` stores downloaded models in a named volume so they persist.
- `-p 11434:11434` maps Ollama's API port to the host.

This requires the NVIDIA Container Toolkit on the host. On Windows, run Docker Desktop with the WSL 2 backend and make sure the NVIDIA driver and GPU support are enabled for WSL. To check that the GPUs are visible inside the container, run:

```bash
docker exec -it ollama nvidia-smi
```

If you want to limit the container to specific GPUs instead, use `--gpus '"device=0,1"'`. I'm not certain of every platform-specific detail, so check the Ollama Docker documentation if the setup differs on your system.
